# Game Jam Foundation instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before editing. This is a beginner-friendly
Godot 4.7.2 GDScript project, so keep changes small, name concepts clearly, and
document new extension points.

- Use the feature-oriented folders described in the root README.
- Preserve the vendored Ninja Adventure source pack and the pixel-art project
  defaults.
- Do not change generated Godot files or add secrets to the repository.
- Run the relevant Godot check after a project change and report the result.
- Do not begin a future roadmap milestone unless the user has reviewed the
  current milestone.
